text:
[IRET.28.0.1] **Goals.** The structure:

- **must** be a single data structure that every table of `[IRET.28.2]`
  uses.
- **must** centralize the probe, backward-shift delete, grow, and load
  machinery so the bug class is fixed in one tested place.
- **must** keep the hot path (the alpha join scan) a flat dense-array
  walk with no per-element indirection, and **must** keep probing
  cache-friendly.
- **must** be deterministic and bit-identical across runs and platforms
  (`[IRET.28.10]`, `[LDET.3.4]`). Its iteration order **must not** feed
  timetag assignment (`[LDET.5.5]`).
- **must** support pre-sizing and a grow-forbidden ("locked") mode for
  real-time use (`[IRET.28.11]`, [RTCT]).
- **must** be exhaustively property / fuzz / invariant tested
  (`[IRET.28.16]`).
